## Where It's Going
Architectural direction: Graph-first, offline-first, MCP-native. The index is the product — MCP is the delivery mechanism. Every feature must be computable from the local graph without calling an LLM. AI is a consumer of the brain, never a component inside it during indexing. | Architectural goals: Zero raw file reads — the brain answers directly from the index, Every output carries an epistemic confidence score, Token minimization is a correctness constraint, not a nice-to-have, The index must stay fresh automatically via git hooks — never manual, Memories and decisions persist across sessions — the brain never forgets, No source code ever leaves the machine — graph metadata only, One MCP server per machine, CWD-routed — zero per-repo config
